name: Helpmate
overview: Scripture reveals that God created man and woman in His image, establishing them as complementary partners (Genesis 1:27). Recognizing man's need for companionship, God made a suitable helpmate to be with him (Genesis 2:18), forming a union where husband and wife become one flesh (Genesis 2:24). The virtuous woman is highly valued, described as more precious than rubies (Proverbs 31:10), while in Christ, distinctions such as male and female are transcended in unity (Galatians 3:28). This underscores the divine design of marriage as a God-ordained partnership reflecting both unity and distinct roles.
